purpose: Customer profile route that shows a manual login CTA when signed out and backend-verified profile details when signed in.
businessRules: The desktop header account icon links here as the manual login/profile entry point.
Signed-out customers see Login to account and can continue browsing without auth.
Signed-in customers see profile identity, customer ID, mapped identity status, verified session expiry, placed order summary, Sign out, and Switch account.
Profile truth comes from SHRESTA-BE through /api/customer-profile; React must not trust localStorage for login state.
